overviewParagraphs: Laem Chabang International Country Club is Jack Nicklaus's most celebrated design in Thailand and the unanimous benchmark for golf in the Pattaya region. The expansive 27-hole facility — divided into Valley, Mountain, and Lake nines — offers a variety of terrain and playing styles that ensures no two visits feel the same, even for regular members.

The Mountain and Valley combination is considered the premium pairing, with the Mountain nine's elevation changes and panoramic views complementing the Valley nine's strategic water features and tree-lined corridors. The Lake nine, while shorter, is relentlessly scenic and tests approach play with demanding pin positions surrounded by water on multiple holes.

For discerning golfers making the Pattaya golf circuit, Laem Chabang is non-negotiable — it is the course that all others in the region are measured against, and it consistently delivers the thorough playing experience and excellent conditioning that Nicklaus's best designs are known for worldwide.

curatorBriefHtml: Laem Chabang International Country Club is a premier Par 72 (any 18 combination) championship layout in Pattaya, Thailand, crafted by Jack Nicklaus (1995) and stretching to 6,772 Yards (Blue Tees) across a rolling hills, lakes, mountain views environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its 27-hole nicklaus tri-course variety (Mountain, Lake, and Valley) and distinct dramatic elevations & rocks (Exposed granite outcroppings).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Laem Chabang International Country Club (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Thailand dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its night golf on mountain course (Premier floodlit layout), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Pattaya golf tour by AGS, Laem Chabang International Country Club provides a distinct architectural test by Jack Nicklaus that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

scorecard.verdict: Considered Jack Nicklaus's finest layout in Thailand. 27 distinct holes weaving through steep rocky hills, natural reservoirs, and scenic valleys. A mandatory inclusion for Pattaya itineraries.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Laem Chabang International Country Club?
faqs.a: Laem Chabang International Country Club in Pattaya, Thailand is a Par 72 (any 18 combination) championship layout designed by Jack Nicklaus (opened 1995), measuring 6,772 Yards (Blue Tees) within a rolling hills, lakes, mountain views setting. It is particularly noted for 27-hole nicklaus tri-course variety (Mountain, Lake, and Valley).

faqs.q: How do I secure tee times and caddies at Laem Chabang International Country Club?
faqs.a: Laem Chabang International Country Club operates under resort & visitor access via ags protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (night golf on mountain course (Premier floodlit layout)), and private VIP transfers from your Pattaya hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Laem Chabang International Country Club?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Laem Chabang International Country Club's distinct dramatic elevations & rocks (Exposed granite outcroppings) alongside 27-hole nicklaus tri-course variety (Mountain, Lake, and Valley). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Laem Chabang International Country Club?
faqs.a: November through April is the prime season for Laem Chabang International Country Club.
